question: Where can I buy Singularity.exe?
answer: On Gamefound, We're selling digitally there operating on a remaining stock model. If you see no listed products there now, then we are all sold out of everything in your geographical region. We dont have any announced plans for if or when future print runs will occur,but do keep an eye on future announcements.

question: How much does it cost?
answer: We have some different product options. They are all listed on the Gamefound page, which is the only place they are kept.

question: When does it ship?
answer: We are aiming to fulfill this fall(September-November 2026)

question: Where do you ship to?
answer: Shipping regions, costs and delivery estimates are shown in the store at checkout — that is the only place they are always current, so we do not mirror a region list here.

question: What is the difference between the core box, the expansions and Incursions?
answer: Three separate boxes: the competitive core game, 4 expansions that each add more cards and new strategies, and the co-op and solo box for one to four players.

question: Do I need the core box to use the expansion or Incursions?
answer: Expansions contain a full deck in each box, the Incursions set requires you to bring your own decks to play against them

question: Are there booster packs or card rarities?
answer: No. There are no random boosters and no rarity system of any kind. Releases are boxed sets: small single-brand or co-op expansions, and large boxes that add a faction and move the story forward.

question: Can I pay in instalments?
answer: instalment plans were availible during the campaign but are not currently availible.

question: Can my local game store stock it?
answer: Yes. Trade, distribution and wholesale enquiries have their own address, not to support.

question: What comes in the core box?
How many characters, brands and programs are there?
answer: Depends on the set you own, For the core server there are 40+ characters and 140+ program cards, the plus is because there's a sealed pack in the box, and to avoid spoilers I'll stop there.

question: Will sleeved cards fit in the insert?
answer: Yes. The insert takes sleeved cards up to 100 microns and it is built so cards and tokens go back in as easily as they come out.

question: Are there playmats?
answer: Premium double stitched playmats exist in the Architech's Edition boxes

question: What size are the cards?
answer: Cards are standard MTG-size (63mm x 88mm)

question: Is the game colour-blind accessible?
answer: Yes. Anything the game distinguishes by colour also carries its own icon, so colour is never the only signal.

question: Will the campaign alt-art cards be available again?
answer: Current Gamefound exclusives in the founders pack 1 will not be reprinted.

question: What language is the game in, and will it be localised?
answer: English, we currently dont have localization plans in the pipeline but if there is enough demand for it, we'd love to make the game more accessible

question: How many people can play?
answer: One to four. The competitive game seats two to four; solo and co-op play run through Incursions, from one player up to a full table of four. four players is mostly a practical limit for gametime, if you have the components and time then you can run with more players

question: How long is a game?
answer: It generally takes around 45 min for a new player to learn the game, for most games after that taking About 30 minutes per player. Very experienced players can play games in 15 min per player

question: What age is it for?
answer: 14 and up.

question: Is there really no randomness?
answer: In PVP, None. No dice, no shuffling, no card draw deciding a turn everything that will happen is already on the table for both of you to read. Incursions will generally randomize their starting states and may randomize the actions they take to some extent as well as part of their turns

link.label: How a turn resolves, rule by rule

question: If nothing is random, is there one optimal strategy?
answer: No, for the same reason chess does not have one: your opponent and their deck are the variable, and the possibility space is enormous.

question: Do I have to build a deck?
answer: No, the core box comes with 4 balanced starter decks and 8 ready-made decklists, and building your own squad is there when you want it and can start with some of the suggestions for how to modify each starter deck.

question: Is there a mulligan or an opening hand?
answer: No. You build your squad in the order you want to play it before the game, rather than drawing an opening hand you stack the deck and there is no hand to redraw and nothing to keep or throw back.

question: What stops one player running everyone's turn in 2v2 and co-op?
answer: Hidden information: you cannot share what is in your program stack or your inactive characters, and your own turn takes enough thought that backseating someone else's is hard work.

question: I have a rules question mid-game. Where do I look?
answer: The rules reference, which is a document that comes with the game, or look at the searchable web version with a link to every individual rule. Changes since printing are in the errata log.

question: What are Incursions?
answer: Co-op/Solo missions against a rogue AI. One to four players share a table against a boss that acts entirely from its own deck and its own rules. Nobody plays the villain, it has a scripted set of moves it makes on it's turns against you.

question: Can I play solo?
answer: Yes. Incursions run from one player up to four, using the same sets of rules between them.

question: Do I need the core box to play Incursions?
answer: You need to bring a deck to play against it, and the core server is a good way to do that. The Incursions box has everything you need to setup the enemy but doesnt include the cards for you to build a deck to use against them.

question: Should I learn the base game first?
answer: Yes. An Incursion assumes you already know how a skirmish plays, then adds the boss's own setup and rules on top.

question: What are the sealed packs inside the Incursion box?
answer: Rewards. Beat all 3 Incursions and you open the sealed pack inside the box, which holds some fun surprise unlocks.

question: Can I just open the sealed packs?
answer: Nothing stops you, no accounts, no tracking, and nothing is destroyed. But, we would rather you earned them because we think it's more fun that way.

question: Is there a print and play?
answer: Yes, downloadable here in the learn section. Includes the core-set and expansion cards as a download, enough to play a real game before you buy anything.

question: Is there a digital version?
answer: There is an official Tabletop Simulator build, free with Tabletop Simulator. It is currently a preview: two players, core and expansion cards, with the rules reference built in.

question: Can I play online against other people?
answer: [PLACEHOLDER — the honest current position on online play beyond Tabletop Simulator. If there is nothing announced, say that rather than saying nothing.]

question: Can I read the rules before I buy?
answer: Yes. The full rulebook and the rules reference are both on this site — readable as web pages, and downloadable as PDFs if you want them on a tablet.

question: Where can I watch it being played?
answer: The how-to-play videos in Learn are the same ones the QR codes in the box point at, and they are captioned.

question: My order is wrong, incomplete or needs a refund.
answer: Support handles orders, refunds and missing components directly — it is the fastest route and the only one that can change an order.

question: A card or component arrived damaged.
answer: Send support a photo and your order number and they will replace it. Do not open a new order to fix it.

question: I need to change my shipping address.
answer: Address changes go through support, and there is a cut-off once fulfilment starts — the earlier you write, the better.

question: Where does the community talk?
answer: Discord. There is a rules desk the designers read, and channels for squad lists and incursion logs.

question: I am press, a reviewer or a content creator.
answer: The press kit has logos, key art, the fact sheet and boilerplate, all self-serve, with a contact address for anything it does not cover.
